More special functions

Source: R/functions-extra.R, R/functions-hyper.R
special-functions-extra.Rd

Rem(p, q) is the remainder with the sign of p. andre(n) gives the Euler zigzag numbers. multigamma(x, p) is the multivariate gamma function, stieltjes(n, a) the Stieltjes constants, riemann_xi(s) Riemann's xi function, owens_t(h, a) Owen's T function, erf2inv(x, y) the inverse of erf2() in its second argument, marcumq(m, a, b) the Marcum Q function. hyper(ap, bq, z) is the generalized hypergeometric function and meijerg(a, b, z) the Meijer G function (with a and b lists of two lists), appellf1() Appell's F1. hn1() and hn2() are the spherical Hankel functions and jn_zeros(n, k) the first k zeros of jn(). SingularityFunction(x, a, n) is the Macaulay bracket. betainc() and betainc_regularized() are the generalized incomplete beta function between two limits. jtheta(n, z, q) is the Jacobi theta function, jacobi_normalized() the orthonormal Jacobi polynomial, Ynm_c() and Znm() the conjugate and real spherical harmonics. mathieus(), mathieuc(), mathieusprime() and mathieucprime() are symbolic only. exp_polar(), polar_lift(), unpolarify(), periodic_argument(), unbranched_argument() and principal_branch() work with numbers on the Riemann surface of the logarithm. piecewise_exclusive() makes the conditions of a Piecewise() mutually exclusive.

Usage

Rem(...)

andre(...)

multigamma(...)

stieltjes(...)

riemann_xi(...)

owens_t(...)

erf2inv(...)

marcumq(...)

appellf1(...)

hn1(...)

hn2(...)

jn_zeros(n, k)

SingularityFunction(...)

betainc(...)

betainc_regularized(...)

jtheta(...)

jacobi_normalized(n, a, b, x)

Ynm_c(n, m, theta, phi)

Znm(n, m, theta, phi)

mathieus(...)

mathieuc(...)

mathieusprime(...)

mathieucprime(...)

exp_polar(...)

polar_lift(...)

unpolarify(e, subs = NULL, exponents_only = FALSE)

unbranched_argument(z)

periodic_argument(z, period)

principal_branch(z, period)

piecewise_exclusive(e)

hyper(ap, bq, z)

meijerg(...)

Arguments

...

Arguments of the symbolic function, in SymPy's order.

n, x, a, b, m, z, k, theta, phi, period, e

Arguments.

subs

For unpolarify(): a named list of values substituted for symbols.

exponents_only

For unpolarify(): only unpolarify exponents.

ap, bq

Lists of upper and lower parameters.

Value

An expression, or a list of Floats for jn_zeros().

Examples

x <- Symbol("x")
Rem(-7, 3)
#> -1
andre(8)
#> 1385
multigamma(x, 2)
#> sqrt(pi)*gamma(x)*gamma(x - 1/2)
SingularityFunction(5, 2, 3)
#> 27
N(hyper(list(1, 2), list(3), Rational(1, 2)))
#> 1.54517744447956
jn_zeros(1, 2)
#> [[1]]
#> 4.49340945790906
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> 7.72525183693771
#>
